title: Submesoscale ocean structure and cloud formation off East Greenland
hero_caption: Schematic, not data: sea ice and cold shelf water stay clear, while cloud streets form over warmer offshore water and above a detached warm eddy.
summary: Submesoscale features within boundary currents contribute to enhanced latent heat fluxes, impacting cloud formation. Combining high spatiotemporal resolution SST data from geostationary satellites with atmospheric reanalysis products, this work will connect how the submesoscales in the East Greenland Current (EGC) system contribute to offshore cloud development near Greenland.
